en.name: Colombia Green Trade Fair
en.description: Chinese EV and solar manufacturers alongside Colombian energy companies. Joint project matchmaking sessions.
en.metaTitle: Colombia Green Trade Fair | LATAM China Tech
en.metaDescription: Chinese EV and solar manufacturers alongside Colombian energy companies. Joint project matchmaking sessions. Bogotá, 30–31 January 2026.
en.overviewHtml: A green-economy trade fair bringing Chinese EV and solar manufacturers together with Colombian energy companies for joint project development.
en.whoShouldAttendHtml: Energy developers, EV and solar equipment manufacturers, and public-sector procurement leads.
en.formatHtml: Exhibition floor, joint-project matchmaking sessions, and policy briefings on green incentives.

br.name: Feira Verde da Colombia
br.description: Fabricantes chineses de veiculos eletricos e energia solar ao lado de empresas colombianas de energia. Sessoes de matchmaking para projetos conjuntos.
br.metaTitle: Feira Verde da Colombia | LATAM China Tech
br.metaDescription: Fabricantes chineses de veiculos eletricos e energia solar ao lado de empresas colombianas de energia. Sessoes de matchmaking para projetos conjuntos. Em Bogota, 30–31 de janeiro de 2026.
br.overviewHtml: Uma feira de economia verde que reune fabricantes chineses de veiculos eletricos e energia solar a empresas colombianas de energia para o desenvolvimento de projetos conjuntos.
br.whoShouldAttendHtml: Desenvolvedores de energia, fabricantes de equipamentos de veiculos eletricos e energia solar, e lideres de compras do setor publico.
br.formatHtml: Piso de exposicao, sessoes de matchmaking de projetos conjuntos e briefings de politicas sobre incentivos verdes.

cn.name: 哥伦比亚绿色贸易展览会
cn.description: 中国电动车及光伏制造商与哥伦比亚能源企业共聚，开展联合项目对接活动。
cn.metaTitle: 哥伦比亚绿色贸易展览会 | LATAM China Tech
cn.metaDescription: 2026年1月30–31日，波哥大，中国电动车及光伏制造商与哥伦比亚能源企业共聚，开展联合项目对接活动。
cn.overviewHtml: 一场绿色经济展览会，将中国电动车及光伏制造商与哥伦比亚能源企业聚集在一起，共同推进项目开发。
cn.whoShouldAttendHtml: 能源开发商、电动车及光伏设备制造商，以及公共部门采购负责人。
cn.formatHtml: 设有展览区、联合项目对接会，以及关于绿色激励政策的简报会。
